name: San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 21, 2019 -
5:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the General Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the June 19, 2019 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2019-08-21 SDWD Item S08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants List.
2019-08-21 SDWD Item S08B Warrants
8C.
Proposed Modification to the October 2019 San Dieguito Water District Board Meeting Schedule. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
Adopt Resolution 2019-18, entitled “A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Approving a Modification to the October 2019 San Dieguito Water District Board Meeting Schedule.”
2019-08-21 SDWD Item S08C Approve Oct 2019 Board Meeting Schedule
8D.
Adoption of Resolution 2019-13 Confirming the Designation of a Proxy to Vote in the Absence of the San Dieguito Water District Representative. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Knoll
District Board adopts Resolution 2019-13 confirming the Santa Fe Irrigation District (Santa Fe) representative be the proxy vote in the absence of the San Dieguito Water District (District) representative for the San Diego County Water Authority member meetings.
2019-08-21 SDWD Item S08D Proxy Designation - SDCWA Representative
8E.
Notice of Completion for City of Encinitas Tentative Map No. 14-111 Public Water Improvements. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Knoll
1) Accept the public water improvements; and 2) Authorize the General Manager to file a Notice of Completion.
2019-08-21 SDWD Item S08E NOC 1412 Mackinnon Ave
8F.
Consider a License Agreement with Rancho Coastal Humane Society Regarding Use of a Portion of the District’s Requeza Yard Property. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Knoll
Approve a License Agreement (Agreement) with Rancho Coastal Humane Society (RCHS) regarding use of a portion of the District’s Requeza Yard property.
2019-08-21 SDWD Item S08F Requeza Yard License Agreement Humane Society
8G.
Freedom Automation As-Needed Consultant Contract. Contact Person: Operations Superintendent Aurora
Authorize the General Manager to enter into a one-year contract of up to $50,000 with an option for five additional one-year terms with Freedom Automation Inc. for a total not to exceed cost of $110,000.
2019-08-21 SDWD Item S08G Freedom Automation As-Needed Consultant Contract
8H.
Authorization to purchase water meters from National Meter and Automation. Contact Person: Operations Superintendent Aurora
Authorize the District to purchase Badger automated meters and registers from National Meter and Automation for FY 2019-20 and FY 2020-21, for up to $100,000 each year for a total not exceed $617,000.
2019-08-21 SDWD Item S08H Authorization to Purchase Water Meters from National Meter and Automation
8I.
Proposed personnel changes to the San Dieguito Water District and a resolution amending the Fiscal Year 2019-20 Adopted Budget. Contact Person: Public Works Director Quiram
1) Change the title of General Manager to Assistant Director of Public Works/Assistant General Manager, upgrade Superintendent to Water Operations Manager and upgrade one Utility Maintenance Specialist to a Utility and Maintenance Supervisor I, as well as approve the related salary adjustments (including addition of Salary Step 10 to Grade 65 and correcting the prior omission of Finance Manager position) that accompany each change; 2) Approve the reorganization of transferring Wastewater Collections under the supervision of the newly created Assistant Director of Public Works/Assistant General Manager of a new Utilities Division of Public Works; 3) Adopt Resolution 2019-15 titled "A Resolution of the San Dieguito Water District Board Approving personnel changes to the Department of Public Works Pay Range Table and Position Titles" which amends the pay scales for the reclassified positions; and 4) Adopt Resolution 2019-16 titled "A Resolution of the San Dieguito Water District Board Amending the Fiscal Year 2019-20 Adopted Budget.”
2019-08-21 SDWD Item S08I Proposed SDWD Personnel Changes
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS - NONE
S11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS - NONE
S12.
BOARD MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
S13.
GENERAL INFORMATION / STAFF STATUS REPORTS
13A.
General Manager Update/Report
S14.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR BOARD MEETING WILL BE HELD ON SEPTEMBER 18, 2019
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
